newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy stake cut by FMR group.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy stake cut by FMR group.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp said Friday it cut its stake in Key Energy Group Inc to 3,774,146 common shares or 34.64 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the sale of 240,000 common shares between December 9 and January 10 at prices ranging from $11.7412 to $12.6043 per share.
FMR Corp is the parent of the investment adviser to Fidelity Funds. Key, based in New Brunswick, N.J., is an oilfield services company, providing well services for oil producers in West Texas.
